# PantryChef SG

> PantryChef SG is a kitchen app for Singapore households. It tracks what is in your pantry and fridge, reminds you before food expires, and suggests recipes to use ingredients up. Made by MAG-AMG Pte Ltd, Singapore.

PantryChef SG also publishes free, sourced food storage guides and grocery price comparisons for Singapore.
